data.title: Use the physical board microphone as the voice input instead of the Mac mic

evidence: "No firmware changes: apps/device/firmware/office_station is unchanged, and the board still has no microphone module in its setup."

data.text: Anders' voice station needs to know whether Leo flashed microphone firmware onto the board (not on main), and if so the start/stop commands and the audio event name, so the board mic can be used as voice input.

evidence: "Can you ask him: 1. Has he flashed new firmware onto the board with the microphone? 2. If so, what are the start/stop commands and the audio event called?"
